editorial.marketOverview: The three-session Nasdaq/QQQ baseline remains bearish with elevated downside risk. Friday's semiconductor-led liquidation, broad weakness and elevated fear are the dominant confirmed market evidence. Sunday has no US cash session, so weekend commentary is not confirmation of a new price trend.
editorial.whatChanged: Newly reviewed weekend market previews emphasize AI valuation concerns, persistent semiconductor weakness and a concentrated holiday-week catalyst calendar. MarketWatch's more precise SOX report (-10.7% Friday, -17.1% weekly) supports rather than changes the previous approximately -11% Friday observation. Open Watch remains unchanged at 174 events.
editorial.marketInterpretation: SOX underperformed the broad Nasdaq materially on Friday; the breadth and volatility picture remains fragile. Friday QQQ -5.67%, Nasdaq Composite -5.28% and VIX 37.66 are reported historical closes. Current VXN, synchronized 2Y/10Y yields, FedWatch probabilities and matched oil contracts are unavailable. No fresh data justify changing the directional call or treating the old +29 bp yield spread as live.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 23: PMI and the opening semiconductor/QQQ relative-strength test determine whether liquidation continues or an oversold bounce develops. Tuesday November 24: consumer confidence and ADI/Dell earnings may reshape demand and hardware sentiment. Wednesday November 25: the concentrated PCE/GDP/durable-goods releases and Beige Book can reprice yields and Fed expectations. These are scenarios, not observed reactions.
editorial.bullCase: A tradable recovery would require QQQ and SOX/SMH rising together, broadening participation, and declining VXN/VIX on aligned timestamps. Strong Nvidia fundamentals and stretched selling create rebound potential, but neither alone confirms a bottom.
editorial.bearCase: If semiconductors keep lagging, breadth remains weak and volatility fails to retreat, Friday's liquidation can extend. Hot inflation, hawkish yield repricing or verified additional regulatory action could intensify the downside, but none is presumed to have happened.
editorial.watchNext: Check synchronized Monday QQQ/Nasdaq, SOX/SMH and breadth; VXN/VIX, 10Y/2Y primary yields, CME FedWatch and same-maturity Brent/WTI. Watch primary Nvidia/SEC filings and curated Open Watch additions; confirm the November 23 PMI, November 24 confidence and earnings, and November 25 PCE/GDP release outcomes before assigning price impact.
